fields.statement: At 6629e1cb2: go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... ./internal/workflow/... -run 'WaitBackoff|MaxInterval' -v passed TestWaitBackoff (fake clock, scripted outputs a a a a a b b; sleeps 30s 60s 120s 120s 120s 30s 60s), TestWaitBackoffStopsAtTimeout (total sleep exactly the 5m timeout), TestWaitMaxInterval (parses 2m, rejects 10s below 30s interval, rejects on a command step) and TestMaxIntervalShipChangeCIWaits (every built-in ship-change ship-check wait has 30s/2m); the full internal/run and internal/workflow packages pass. A build of this commit ran rhiza workflow check on each .rhiza/workflows/*.toml (bugfix, docs*, plan-bug, ship-change): all exit 0. Read the diff: all 7 ship-check waits in both the repo and built-in ship-change set max_interval 2m (bugfix includes ship-change); the production Condition runner returns the check's output tail, so backoff resets on changed output.
